title: THE MAGNET POWER-UP IS GONE
why: His words of 2026-10-15 about the magnet power-up: I do not like the idea, get rid of it. The magnet is removed completely: it no longer drops, it has no pickup, no effect, no picture, no timer chip, no note and no callout, and the sound pack carries no cue for it. The other five power-ups (bottomless clip, double damage, rapid fire, shield bubble, screen clear) stay and drop as before; there is one kind fewer on the drop table. The older checks that tested the magnet now test that no power-up moves a box.
now: The magnet power-up is gone; the other five power-ups stay.
